mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_content_block (name, slug, block_type, content_html, content_raw, description, status, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{blockType}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentRaw}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_content_block SET name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, block_type = #{blockType}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, content_raw = #{contentRaw}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_content_block WHERE slug = #{slug})
